outcome: Maternal morbidity (nontransfusion severe maternal morbidity, critical care procedures, cardiac complications, acute renal failure, and transfusion)
Adverse pregnancy outcomes (preterm birth, hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, and cesarean delivery)
DKA at antepartum and postpartum hospitalizations
cohort: 392,796 pregnant individuals with pregestational diabetes (type 1 and 2 diabetes mellitus) hospitalized for delivery in the United States between 2010 and 2020
finding: The frequency of DKA at delivery hospitalization and antepartum hospitalizations for DKA increased between 2010 and 2020 among deliveries in individuals with pregestational diabetes in the United States, and DKA was associated with an increased risk of maternal morbidity and adverse pregnancy outcomes.
